views.name: marquee_episode_completion_coverage
views.definition:
SELECT user_id,
    episode_id,
    bool_or(dated) AS has_dated_watch,
    bool_or(undated) AS has_undated_completion
   FROM ( SELECT marquee_watch_history.user_id,
            marquee_watch_history.episode_id,
            true AS dated,
            false AS undated
           FROM marquee_watch_history
          WHERE marquee_watch_history.episode_id IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
         SELECT marquee_undated_completions.user_id,
            marquee_undated_completions.episode_id,
            false AS dated,
            true AS undated
           FROM marquee_undated_completions
          WHERE marquee_undated_completions.episode_id IS NOT NULL) evidence
  GROUP BY user_id, episode_id;

views.name: marquee_movie_completion_coverage
views.definition:
SELECT user_id,
    movie_title_id,
    bool_or(dated) AS has_dated_watch,
    bool_or(undated) AS has_undated_completion
   FROM ( SELECT marquee_watch_history.user_id,
            marquee_watch_history.movie_title_id,
            true AS dated,
            false AS undated
           FROM marquee_watch_history
          WHERE marquee_watch_history.movie_title_id IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
         SELECT marquee_undated_completions.user_id,
            marquee_undated_completions.movie_title_id,
            false AS dated,
            true AS undated
           FROM marquee_undated_completions
          WHERE marquee_undated_completions.movie_title_id IS NOT NULL) evidence
  GROUP BY user_id, movie_title_id;

functions.name: marquee_guard_sync_runs
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.marquee_guard_sync_runs()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if old.status <> 'running' or new.status = 'running' or
     (new.id, new.source, new.scope_key, new.started_at) is distinct from
     (old.id, old.source, old.scope_key, old.started_at) or
     new.user_id is distinct from old.user_id or
     new.execution_id is distinct from old.execution_id then
    raise exception 'marquee sync run can only transition once to a terminal outcome';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE

AS $function$
  select coalesce(m.title_id, m.show_title_id, m.movie_title_id, m.season_id, m.episode_id)

$function$
